purpose: Decide whether full label-reuse-to-local merits the existing confirmatory investment; never a confirmatory result itself.

required: all existing holds and protected cohorts excluded with closure
record-consistent global edges drawn only from local execution endpoints
same-version actual Cards/G/L build and hashes

training.common_cap: one complete eligible record-consistent G pass plus one complete L pass
training.baseline: cycle fixed L order; stop before the next whole pair exceeds common cap
inherited: fixed task-conditioned head25-tail75 serialization without score or execution feedback
effective pair batch 128 with the existing verified partial-update normalization
ceil(0.03*valid-token cap) warmup then constant learning rate
no optimizer or learning-rate restart at G/L boundary
final checkpoint only; restart from identical initial checkpoint for each fit

readout.population: separately admitted development local siblings, not protected confirmation
readout.timing: complete and hash-lock all four final checkpoints and same-pool predictions before the joint development readout
readout.score_ties: preserve frozen source eligibility; no outcome-dependent removal
readout.primary: within-task pair-average credit difference; equal-task average per seed; average the two seed effects
readout.uncertainty: descriptive task-clustered paired 95% interval and leave-one-task-out; training seeds are not independent tasks
readout.interval_definition: inherit the parent readout task bootstrap algorithm with seed 20260905 and 20000 replicates, aggregating exactly the two registered screen seeds; do not feed this screen into the five-arm confirmatory verdict
readout.same_pool_tfidf: required train-only fixed baseline, initialization/query cost counted; no dev tuning

investment_decision.positive_screen: all four fits finish without integrity faults, both seed effects strictly positive, two-seed task-macro mean at least 0.02, and leave-one-task-out mean never negative
investment_decision.meaning: candidate worth further confirmation, not proof of mechanism, significance, scaling or agent improvement
investment_decision.both_nonpositive: do not escalate to larger models or the 15-fit stage
investment_decision.mixed_sign_small_effect_or_uncertain: inconclusive; no automatic matrix expansion or seed rescue
investment_decision.optimization_failure: report separately from lack of method effect; preserve failures; any changed optimizer/token plan is a new development version
investment_decision.confirmation: original five arms and three seeds, same-pool TF-IDF and all hierarchy gates remain unchanged; independent untouched cohort access still separately required

execution_blockers: exact checkpoint and consumer GPU acceptance
real encoded plan counts and peak memory
actual train-only loader and dev isolation
